neurips.name: NeurIPS
neurips.notes: Single-column layout; figures span the 5.5in text width. Soft pastel zone backgrounds, rounded modules, and rich iconography are common in methodology diagrams. Sans-serif labels.

iclr.name: ICLR
iclr.notes: Single-column layout, same 5.5in text width as NeurIPS. Diagrams tend to be slightly more minimal; clear left-to-right flow and restrained colors.

icml.name: ICML
icml.notes: Two-column layout. Single-column figures are only 3.25in wide, so keep labels large and layouts compact; use full-width (6.75in) figures for pipelines with many stages.

cvpr.name: CVPR / ICCV / ECCV
cvpr.notes: Two-column vision venues. Architecture diagrams often include image thumbnails and feature-map blocks; spatial/geometric precision is valued. Full-width teaser figures at the top of page 1 are common.

acl.name: ACL / EMNLP / NAACL
acl.notes: Two-column NLP venues with a narrow 3.03in column. Prefer vertical or compact layouts for single-column figures; example text snippets and token sequences are common visual elements.

aaai.name: AAAI
aaai.notes: Two-column layout. Conservative styling; keep color count low and ensure grayscale legibility.
